AI AGENT FRAMEWORK · VISUAL MAP

From a user request to controlled, useful actions

Give an agent a goal. The framework connects its model to permitted tools, saved state, and rules for making progress.

02 · Building blocks

A model makes decisions; other pieces make them usable

questions.stem: User Task ఇచ్చినప్పుడు AI Agent Request Understand చేసి, Tool Select చేసి, Action Execute చేసి, Result Observe చేసి Task Complete అయ్యిందో ఎలా Decide చేస్తుంది?
options: Framework User Request Read చేయకముందే Every Connected Tool Run చేస్తుందని అంటుంది. ఇది User Goal Ignore చేసి Waste Creates.
Model Complete Answer First Write చేస్తుంది; Tool Results Return అవ్వవు అంటుంది. Agent Next Stepకి Tool Observations Need.
Agent Task Understand చేసి Authorized Tool Select, Execute, Result Review చేస్తుంది; Completionకి Depending Repeat లేదా Stop చేస్తుంది.
Framework Every Request All Toolsకి Send చేసి Fastest Result Trust చేస్తుందని అంటుంది. Tool Selection, Validation, Stop Rules Needed.
questions.explanation: Explanation: Fridayకి Meeting Room Find చేయమని Assistantని అడిగారని Suppose చేయండి. First Requestని Read చేసి Room-Availability Tool Call చేస్తుంది. Results చూసిన తర్వాత Room Choose చేయమని Ask చేయవచ్చు లేదా Reserve చేయడానికి Permission Request చేయవచ్చు. Tool Authorized Booking Confirm చేసిన తర్వాత Finish అవుతుంది. ఇదే Observe-and-Decide Loop: Understand → Act → Inspect → అవసరమైతే Continue. Tool Result Next Stepకి Guide చేయాలి; Agent All Toolsని Blindగా Run చేయకూడదు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct: C. Typical Loop: Request Accept → Context Build → Model Next Action Suggest → Tool Name, Arguments Verify → Permitted Tool Execute → Result Observe → Repeat or Finish. Completion Final Answer లేదా Stop Policyతో Decide అవుతుంది. Max Iterations, Cost Budget, Approval, Error Handling Support చేయాలి. Models Arbitrary API Access Directగా Obtain చేయవు.

questions.figure:
05 · Build in Python

Turn a normal Python function into an agent tool

Production difference: Add persistent state, bounded calls, error handling, and tests before using live tools.

from langchain.agents import create_agent
from langchain.tools import tool

@tool
def lookup_order(order_id: str) -> str:
    """Return a read-only order status."""
    return {"A7": "shipped"}.get(order_id, "not found")

agent = create_agent(
    model="openai:gpt-4.1-mini",
    tools=[lookup_order],
    system_prompt="Use the lookup tool for orders."
)
result = agent.invoke({"messages": [
    {"role": "user", "content": "Check order A7"}
]})
Minimum testsValid ID → shippedUnknown ID → not foundTool error → recoverWrite action → approval

questions.stem: Multi-Agent Systemsలో Supervisor Agents, Specialists, Task Delegation, Shared State, Messaging, Conditional Routing, Parallel Execution, Human Approval ఎలా Coordinate అవుతాయి? Centralized, Decentralized Approaches Trade-offs ఏమిటి?
options: Decentralized Agents Every Decisionకి Permanent Supervisor Require అంటుంది. Peer-to-Peer Coordination Possible, Safeguards Required.
Shared State ఉంటే Everyone Every Task చేయవచ్చని అంటుంది. Specialist Responsibilities Duplicate Work Reduce చేయవచ్చు.
Parallel Agents Conflicts Remove, Human Review Unnecessary అంటుంది. Shared Resourcesని Change చేస్తే Concurrent Decisions Disagree కావచ్చు.
Supervisor Work Assign, Approvals Manage చేస్తుంది; Decentralized Agents Messagesతో Coordinate చేస్తాయి; Both Reliable Shared State, Conflict Handling Need.
questions.explanation: Explanation: Film-Production Team Shoot Plan చేస్తోందని Imagine చేయండి. One Agent Locations Check చేస్తుంది; Another Equipment Estimate చేస్తుంది; Third Schedule Prepare చేస్తుంది. Supervisor Agent Tasks Assign చేసి Results Combine చేయవచ్చు. Decentralized Designలో Specialists Directగా Communicate చేయవచ్చు. Both Approaches Conflicting Information, Task Ownership, Shared State, Expensive Decisionsకి Human Approval Handle చేయాలి. Parallel Work Time Save చేయవచ్చు కానీ Duplicate Actions, Disagreements Automatically Prevent చేయదు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct: D. Centralized Supervisor Delegation, Routing, Review, Shared State Maintain చేస్తుంది; Oversight Easier కానీ Bottleneck/Single Failure Risk. Decentralized Specialists Events, Messages Direct Exchange చేస్తారు; Autonomy, Concurrency Better కావచ్చు కానీ Loops, Duplicate Work, Inconsistent State Risk. Task Ownership, Concurrency Controls, Budgets, Idempotent Handoffs, Sensitive Actionsకి Human Approval Both Approachesలో Needed.
questions.figure:
06 · Multi-agent coordination

One supervisor or a network of specialists?

Trade-off: Supervision simplifies oversight but can bottleneck; peer workflows are flexible but harder to coordinate.

questions.stem: Production AI Agentsలో Checkpointing, Durable Execution, Retries, Idempotency, Permissions, Prompt-Injection Defense, Observability, Evaluation, Cost, Latency, Partial Failure Recovery ఎలా Design చేస్తాం?
options: Checkpoints, Idempotent Tools, Limited Permissions, Traces, Recovery Tests Use చేసి Paymentలాంటి Sensitive Actionని Duplicate చేయకుండా Resume చేయవచ్చు.
Every Failed Paymentని Succeededనా Check చేయకుండా Immediately Retry చేయాలని అంటుంది. Side Effects Duplicate Charges Create చేయవచ్చు.
Tool Logs Store చేసి Outcomes Skip చేయాలని అంటుంది. API Success అంటే User Goal Always Correctగా Complete అయిందని కాదు.
Every Tool Default Allow చేస్తే Prompt Injection Reduce అవుతుందంటుంది. Broad Access Wrong Actions Damage Increase చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Explanation: Invoice Payment Prepare చేసే Agentని Imagine చేయండి. Connection Payment Succeed అయిన తర్వాత కానీ Confirmation Receive కాకముందే Fail కావచ్చు. Blind Retry Double Paymentకి దారి తీయవచ్చు. Idempotency Key Repeated Requestsని Safer చేస్తుంది; Checkpoint Completed Steps Store చేసి Workflow Resume చేయడంలో Help చేస్తుంది. Tool Permissions, Approval Gates Agent Actions Limit చేస్తాయి. Logs, Evaluation, Error Tests Failures Investigate చేయడంలో Help చేస్తాయి. Production Reliability అంటే Blindly Retry కాదు, Safely Recover అవడం.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct: A. Production Reliabilityకి Durable Checkpoints, Resuming, Backoff Retries, Idempotency Keys, Least-Privilege Tools, Human Approvals, Untrusted Tool Output Validation Need. Prompt Injection Retrieved Contentలో కూడా ఉండవచ్చు; Instructions కాక Dataగా Treat చేయాలి. Traces, Success/Failure Evaluations, Token/Cost/Latency Limits Maintain చేయాలి. Tool Succeed అయిన తర్వాత Timeout అయితే Retry Before External State Reconcile చేసి Duplicates Avoid చేయాలి.
questions.figure:
07 · Production reliability

Retries must not repeat real-world actions

Key rule: Durable agents need checkpoints, idempotent actions, permissions, evaluation, and clear retry limits.
